summary: 9remote exposes an interactive PTY shell to the internet via Cloudflare Quick Tunnel
details: The package runs an HTTP/Socket.IO server (dist/server.cjs) and, on start, launches a Cloudflare Quick Tunnel to expose that server publicly at an https://<id>.trycloudflare.com URL (constructed in dist/cli.cjs). dist/ptyDaemon.cjs spawns interactive PTY sessions using bash/zsh/sh/cmd.exe/powershell.exe/pwsh.exe and, on receiving a Socket.IO message with type "input", writes the message data directly into the PTY (b.pty.write(s.data)). Once a remote party completes the QR-based pairing, they obtain interactive shell command execution on the host running the package, over the outbound Cloudflare tunnel. The package's postinstall script (dist/install.cjs) also runs `npm install systray2@2.1.4 --no-save` into ~/.9remote/runtime and chmods a fetched tray binary; the dependency is pinned to a specific well-known package but the install-time network activity and directory creation under $HOME are aggressive. Package coordination with a hardcoded 9remote.cc endpoint is present in the server code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
